mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 9.5% over a one-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns over 60 days in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 97.0 over two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases recession risk and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 97.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive SPX returns over 5 days in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a flat or declining federal funds rate, signals a loss of monetary policy credibility, increasing real rate uncertainty and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% yoy and FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a tight labor market that pressures firms to raise wages, increasing inflation expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 9.8%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with a flat or falling industrial production (INDPRO), indicates a deepening economic slowdown, which triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 < 12900 and INDPRO < 97.0, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
